<!--
Before opening a feature request, please check:

1. The same request does not already exist (search the open and closed issues).
2. It is not already listed on the ROADMAP.
3. It is not explicitly out of scope for the project, as documented in
   docs/policies/10-what-we-dont-support.md.
-->

## The problem

<!--
Describe the problem you are trying to solve, not the solution you have
in mind. "I cannot do X" is more useful than "I want a button for X".

If this is a real problem for a real system you run, say so. Concrete
use cases weigh heavily in deciding what gets built.
-->

## What you have tried

<!--
Workarounds, alternatives, why they do not fit. Optional but useful.
-->

## A solution you would find acceptable

<!--
Your best guess at what would solve the problem. It does not have to be
the final design — the maintainers will discuss it. Optional.
-->

## Would this change the security boundary?

<!--
Yes / No / Not sure.

If this could affect authentication, holds, execution, the outbox, or
the audit trail, say so. Changes to the boundary get a closer review
and may need a design discussion before any code is written.
-->

## Additional context

<!--
Links, prior art, related issues. Optional.
-->
